sql: SELECT t.rowid,j.rowid,j._rowid_,j.oid FROM t1 t CROSS JOIN json_each('[10,20]') j WHERE t.rowid<3
SELECT t.rowid,j.rowid FROM t1 t LEFT JOIN json_each('[]') j ON 1 WHERE t.rowid<3
SELECT t.rowid,count(j.rowid) FROM t1 t LEFT JOIN json_each('[]') j ON 1 GROUP BY t.rowid HAVING t.rowid<3
SELECT sum(j.rowid),sum(j._rowid_),sum(j.oid) FROM t1 t CROSS JOIN json_each('[10,20]') j
SELECT j.rowid,count(*) FROM t1 t CROSS JOIN json_each('[10,20]') j GROUP BY j.rowid
SELECT sum(t.rowid),sum(t._rowid_),sum(t.oid) FROM t1 t CROSS JOIN json_each('[10,20]') j
SELECT count(j.rowid),sum(j.rowid) FROM t1 t LEFT JOIN json_each('[]') j ON 1
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.rowid=1) FROM t1 t CROSS JOIN json_each('[10,20]') j
SELECT j._rowid_,count(*) FROM t1 t CROSS JOIN json_each('[10,20]') j GROUP BY j._rowid_ HAVING j.oid=1
